_doc: OPS-SESSION-BUDGET-W1 — every threshold and price scripts/session-budget.mjs reads. Nothing in the script hardcodes a number; a ratchet is a one-number edit here. The script, the hooks it serves, the installer and the tests all read this one file.
window_reason: autoCompactWindow the installer writes into ~/.claude/settings.json. Auto-compaction fires near window - 33k (measured 466,299-469,623 on a 500k window, 11 events, R0), so a request above the window means the window was not applied or one turn overshot it (ruling Q1).
overshoot_follow_requests_reason: A request above the window followed by a compact_boundary within this many main requests is OVERSHOOT; none is WINDOW_NOT_APPLIED (ruling Q1).
share_threshold_reason: The cost-weighted share of usage above this context is the figure /usage reports (E1: 94% on 2026-10-23); the readout trends it.

cold_cache.idle_reason: 55 min: inside the 1 h cache TTL every measured session writes with (5 m writes = 0 in R0), so a prompt after this gap meets a cold cache.
cold_cache.min_context_reason: Below this a cold re-write costs too little to hold a prompt for.
cold_cache.rewrite_min_reason: A main request writing more than this after an idle gap is a cold re-write, not new content.
cold_cache.max_human_rewrites_reason: A session with more human-triggered cold re-writes is OVER (ruling Q2 + AC7 CLOSE_WHEN); machine-triggered ones are reported, never judged.

dispatch.regex_reason: The spec's [^ ]+ also matches a newline, so a prompt ending one line in .md and the next in Prompt/x.md named a wave spanning both; [^\s]+? stops at the first .md.
dispatch.base_strip_reason: A -V2 or -R2 spec is a later dispatch of the same wave (ruling Q6; Prompt/ held 11 -V2, 1 -V3, 1 -R2 on 2026-10-23).

exempt_prompt_prefixes_reason: UserPromptSubmit fires on these machine turns (measured in ~/.claude/session-log.md: 3,680 / 110 / 59 / 10 / 4 for the five of ruling Q2; then 30 <system-reminder — side-session wake-ups and started-task notices the Desktop app sends — and 2 <<autonomous-loop — /loop wake-ups — found at CH3, 2026-10-23). Nobody is there to re-send a held one, so the cold-cache hold skips them and counts the skip (ruling Q2). Human-typed shapes that also start with < (<bash-input, <pasted_content, <!-- reply) stay judged.
skill_name_only_reason: A user skill goes name-only when no retained transcript invokes it AND Claude Code's own skillUsage counter has no use inside this window (ruling Q3).
long_session_reason: The readout trends the cost share of sessions active this long (E4: 89% of 7-day cost on 2026-10-23); AC7 drives it down by ending one-wave sessions.
latest_max_rows_reason: Rows of the per-session table in session-budget-latest.md, newest first. Display only: every aggregate in the readout is computed over all sessions in the window.
backfill_idle_reason: SessionEnd is not proven to fire for every Desktop session, so each ledger write also appends a line for any session idle this long that has none.
hook_timeout_reason: The installer writes this as the timeout of the UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart(compact) registrations, so a hung meter delays a prompt by at most this long instead of the hook default. The measured p95 sits far below it (status.md entry).
files_reason: OPS-STATUS-INDEX-LEDGER-W1: byte caps on the vault files every session reads. ops/scripts/status-append.mjs refuses (OVER) a status.md write over its cap and its --report prints all three. status.md = trim-status-config max_bytes. AOE-status.md and CLAUDE.md are pinned at their measured size on 2026-10-23, so growth shows in --report. scripts/session-budget.mjs does not read this key.
bytes_per_token_source: E5 calibration: vault CLAUDE.md 32,084 B = 12.9k tokens in /context (2026-10-23). Used only for the est_tokens of tool results, which carry no usage of their own.

prices.source: claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-10-06) + its prompt-caching economics; list prices, USD per million tokens

baseline.first_request_instrument: transcript message.usage of vault session d094828e request 1, dedup by message.id, 2026-10-23
